name: Pathfinder 1e Core
description: Seed content packs for the Pathfinder 1e integration: the spells the mass-battle engine can resolve (75 entries, 4 automated and 71 declared descriptive-only), the bestiary mirrors the unit profiles compile from, the six-class starter table, the equipment/armor/shield tables the resolver's own weapon and item tables mirror, and the feats that affect calculations. Character sheets and the tactical (hero-level) rules are in-repo UI, not a package script, so this package is data-only — declare code here only when a sandboxed module.js actually exists.
